title: Run
description: A horror ModPack with lots of scary entities!
body:
In this ModPack,\
you'll get spooked by some entities...\
Nobody knows how they got into this world,\
so be ready or everything and anything.

Defend yourself with guns,knifes, make bunkers.\
You never know whats coming.

Features:

- Guns
- Amazing Terrain
- Scary entities
- And more to uncover...

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
